findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed employee wash hands and not use a barrier to turn off hand sink. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and hands were rewashed. Ensure a barrier is used is used when turning off hand sink to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.12(C) Cleaning Procedure. (C) To avoid recontaminating their hands or surrogate prosthetic devices, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a HANDWASHING SINK or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed a bottle of milk to be missing date marking. Discussed with PIC, education as provided and the correct date was marked on milk. Ensure any open TCS items is properly date marked after 24 hours.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed sanitizer solution to be at 300 ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer bottle was remade and tested at 100pm CL. Ensure sanitizer solution is prepared at the proper sanitization level.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(B) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (B) An iodine solution shall have a: (1) Minimum temperature of 20°C (68°F), (2) PH of 5.0 or less or a PH no higher than the level for which the manufacturer specifies the solution is effective, and (3) Concentration between 12.5 MG/L and 25 MG/L.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. Wall directly under the napkin dispenser at the kitchen hand sink has paint coming away - repaint the wall so it is smooth and easily cleanable.
2. The 3 compartment sink has caulking missing/coming away - re-caulk the triple sink between the basins and the wall.
3. The wall directly under the soap dispenser in the women’s bathroom has damaged dry wall - coming away. Repair the wall so it is smooth and easily cleanable.
4. The storage room in the kitchen has shelving on the wall. The shelves are bare wood - seal with paint and/or clear coat sealant so the shelves are non-absorbent. 

Discussed repairs with PIC. Ensure repairs are conducted by the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) A test kit was not available for the sanitizer bottle used in the kitchen. The facility received a few test strips to get them through until the next batch could be acquired.
